loop.top3_series_pattern: trend_dominated, high predictability, unstable model ranking across windows
loop.top3_why: The series is strongly trend‑dominated with little seasonality and exhibits unstable model rankings across the three validation windows. A robust, simple combination that averages over the most consistently ranked models (pool2) provides stable per‑window performance (≈0.69–0.706) and avoids the high variance seen in the weighted scheme. The mean over the 7 models in pool2 balances bias and variance and is likely to generalize better to the blind test window.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B, while having the lowest overall validation score, shows extreme per‑window variability (0.766, 0.408, 0.714) indicating overfitting to the limited validation set. Candidate C (median) is also robust but its per‑window scores are slightly higher and the mean combination already achieves a comparable, more stable result. Therefore B is less appropriate, and C offers no clear advantage over A.
